decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are thermoforming materials for dental laboratories, squarely within the firm's core material knowledge, and in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product.
A PETG thermoforming blank extends the firm's established thermoforming material line, so absorptive capacity is high and the product fits its dental laboratory channels.
A UV-curing lacquer builds on the firm's light-curing materials expertise and digital production workflows, though it was only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests a lower priority.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build on the firm's core custom earmold manufacturing skills for hearing-care retailers, but the discontinuation of the related earmold line E signals some risk in this segment.
